About Tanaya

Meet Tanaya
Chaudhari

"For the soul that knows there is more to life than merely coping."

I'm a Globally Certified Access Bars® Practitioner and Life Coach based in Pune. My work is rooted in helping individuals release what has been holding them back — emotional wounds, limiting beliefs, and nervous system dysregulation.

Through a blend of trauma-informed coaching, energy healing and Akashic Records, I guide people toward deeper healing, healthier relationships, inner peace and an abundant, flowing life.
